text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Bamboo Memory and Yaeno 
Muteki were doing special training deep in 
the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not enough momentum! If you do not conquer 
your fear, you will never be able to 
shatter a boulder!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! Running on water... Why can't I 
break past the 30 cm barrier?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You lack fighting spirit! Even as your 
body begins to sink, you must keep running 
without giving up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Is this your limit? You are still a 
long way from being the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's... not true at all! My feelings 
won't just end here! I'll definitely, 
definitely—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna master that manga's secret 
technique--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That fiery, heart-igniting secret 
technique... is definitely what I've been 
missing!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I was surprised when you 
asked to train in the secret arts that 
day."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it is an imaginary technique, I 
shall master it." Seeing her approach it 
with such dedication— I was deeply 
moved...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I won't let your expectations down, no 
matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right off the bat! For the next special 
training, we're gonna need to go 
skydiving, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, Ardan has a 
private helicopter. Let's go ask her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Bamboo Memory continued to 
carry out seemingly reckless special 
training one after another, gaining 
various insights along the way.
